findings.text: Earlier MAJOR fixed: main() posts only when no status with the context exists on the head; mocked-API tests cover failure, error, pending, success and the no-status case.
Statuses lookup reads one page of 100 with no pagination; a head with over 100 statuses could hide an older review status. Very unlikely.
Once any review status exists on a head, the workflow never approves that head; the owner sets it by hand. Matches intent and is documented.
Docs describe post-only-if-absent and self-attested receipts. pr-evidence.yml still runs PR-supplied scripts on pull_request, as before.
Octopus, unmerged-branch and reviewed-as-second-parent tests match the code paths they claim.
